familyDefinition: A state variable survives a change of paid bet while a state-dependent award or feature is valued from the current/triggering paid bet. This creates structural build/exercise leverage but is not positive EV until transition probabilities, build economics and exercise value are closed for the exact served operator build.

researchPriority: Unstoppable Wolf is structurally strongest because its terminal five-indicator trigger is visible, persisted across bet changes, its feature stake is explicitly the triggering spin stake, and Interwetten publishes a 200x endpoint range. This is a closure-priority statement, not an EV claim.
remainingCoreGates: exact served runtime state visibility without paid probing
conditional transition probability to terminal event from the visible state
conservative feature-value distribution/floor at trigger stake
full low-stake build-cost distribution including resets and ordinary returns
